Name: Another Hunger Mod Revival 1.6
Author: qwertyblahblah
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Golden Age modder already know about this mod its one of the best, this features a simple hunger system from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3379]Another Hunger Mod[/url]
1.4 stardew having fullness gives you speed, attack and defense and having zero hungerbar drains your health. Revived for 1.6!

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Run the game using SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Full? get speed, attack, defense boost. hungry? get nothing, starving? die slowly

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Optional Requirements
Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
Inspired by Stardew Valley 1.4 mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3379]Another Hunger Mod[/url] created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34250790]SpaceChase0[/url] ps i still use the hungerbar with the egg

Sauce Code: [url=https://github.com/astecas-plug/AnotherHungerModRevived]https://github.com/astecas-plug/AnotherHungerModRevived[/url]
Feel free to dl it tweak and rebuild it, the dlls dependencies are still there so you wont have to setup env

Original:
[url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods[/url]

[size=4][b]Caution:[/b][/size]
[b]When starting a new playthrough and you decided not to tweak my default config you should give yourself 40energy tonic or 80pizza or 160salad (by cheating/using save editor) just so you can survive til you have stable money to buy your own food cause my default requires you to eat a lot every 5hours and 30minute ingame time, and somehow the farmer (you) decided to quit work with only 500g in the bank![/b]

Mod uses item Edibility for calculating satiety similar to the great Another Hunger Mod so any custom cooking mod should still contribute to your fullness. This doesnt rely on massive blob of array for each item satiety

Glazed Yam is your friend with cheap ingredient yam and sugar and you have good food idk tho that was back in 1.4 so theres prolly superior food with superior edibility now

[b][size=4]Compatiblity:[/size][/b]
• Android (Mobile): Fully Tested & Working (Built and verified on SMAPI Android).
• PC (Windows / Mac / Linux): Compatible — Built using clean, standard SMAPI APIs (RenderedHud, TimeChanged, UpdateTicked) with zero platform-specific code.
